items.q: And I would catch him every morning, and as time went along that kind of listening began to just turn my mind around.

ctx.x: He had it down. He had it together. And I would catch him every morning, and as time went along that kind of listening began to just turn my mind around. But the Ellington situation was the thing that did it.
